prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production transparent HD 2D real-time-strategy vehicle sprite sheet, visual pilot for Dune II.
Input Image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET: six recovered original vehicle poses in a regular THREE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid. The dark gray background is only reference padding and must become genuinely transparent.

Redraw each whole connected vehicle as crisp, carefully hand-painted high-resolution game art. Keep the exact six identities, row-major order, proportions, facing directions, placement and relative sizes from the reference. Top row: the same compact Atreides THREE-WHEELED TRIKE facing straight NORTH (up), NORTHEAST (upper right), and EAST (right). Three wheels total per trike: one forward wheel with the narrow front and two rear wheels with the wider rear. Bottom row: the same compact LIGHT TRACKED TANK, hull and its SINGLE forward gun barrel aligned, facing NORTH, NORTHEAST, and EAST. Two parallel treads per tank; do not add wheels, barrels, wings or ornaments.

CAMERA INVARIANT: very high-overhead orthographic tactical-game camera, matching the recovered poses. The NORTH vehicle is symmetric in plan view and points directly toward the top of its cell; the EAST vehicle points directly right. Keep the reference projection. Do not tilt the camera into a glamour three-quarter product illustration, low isometric perspective, foreshortened toy render or rear-view angle.

Style: polished sharp painted 2D RTS sprite art, clean purposeful contours, strong readable medium-scale body/tread/wheel forms, restrained hard-surface shading and subtle panel detail. Cobalt blue faction armor, cool steel/silver mechanical surfaces and dark charcoal tires/treads, preserving the reference's dominant colour blocks. Soft upper-left illumination with crisp form edges; readable when reduced to about64px per vehicle. Reconstruct the complete semantic objects with clean new curves, lines, metal highlights and RGBA shading, rather than painting texture into every old source pixel.

No pixel blocks, pixel mosaic, visibly enlarged squares, blurry interpolation, xBR-style melting, haze, generic grain or microtexture overlay, thick black cartoon/toy outlines, photoreal floor, added sci-fi decorations, extra props, text, labels, borders, cell lines, logos, ground planes, long shadows or background scene. Exactly six isolated complete objects, ONE per equal cell, generous transparent gutters and margins. The same trike design must remain consistent across its three views; likewise the tank across its three views. Output a sharp1536×1024 or comparable landscape transparent sheet, preserving the3×2 arrangement.
